method.returnWindow: UTC midnight to UTC midnight, 1 calendar day
method.rank: Current market cap at daily collection, after excluding Bitcoin and stablecoins
method.historical: Before first observation: today’s 200-coin cohort and today’s fixed rank groups; survivorship bias. Not historical market-cap membership.
method.ties: Equal BTC returns are not outperformers
method.missing: Missing daily prices excluded from denominator, never counted as losses
method.stablecoins: CoinGecko stablecoins, yield-bearing-stablecoins, bridged-stablecoins, commodity-backed-stablecoin, tokenized-products; dynamic category classification
method.schedule: Daily 02:20 UTC; GitHub Actions schedules can be delayed
